note:
Rebuilds the homepage review section in the Tatcha register — large model-application image per review, quote, and a link through to the product — but built from the theme's OWN multi-column module rather than a custom section, per Malcolm's instruction to use native elements first.

Why not the theme's testimonials section: its block does take an image, but the Liquid renders it at `sizes: (max-width: 699px) 40px, 56px`. It is an avatar by design and can never carry a large image. multi-column's item block natively supports image + title + richtext + link_url + link_text, which is the Tatcha structure minus the mini product thumbnail and price — the only two parts that would require hand-built markup.

Images are Malcolm's own double-underscore picks from the 2026 product run, already live on the product pages, re-uploaded to Files under new names because theme sections resolve shopify://shop_images against Files and cannot address product media. The originals are untouched (shopify.md rule 7).

The quotes are the EXISTING placeholder copy, kept per Malcolm's decision to supply real reviews before launch. Two things for him to fix at that point: the star rating is carried as text since multi-column has no rating control, and review 3 is attributed to 'Marco R.' while the image shows a woman.
